evidence: Tasks in active view are sorted by priority: Review project proposal (High), Complete tax filing (High), Submit final report (High), Schedule dentist appointment (Medium), Buy groceries (Low). High-priority tasks appear before medium-priority, and medium before low.

After selecting Deadline sort, tasks are ordered: Buy groceries (Tomorrow), Review project proposal (Aug 26), Submit final report (Aug 29), Schedule dentist appointment (Aug 31), Complete tax filing (Sep 7). Earliest deadlines appear first.
Task "Test Task FT4" was created with a non-empty title. Notification confirmed creation, active count increased from 2 to 3, and task appears in active list.

Task "Test Task FT5 Complete" created with all details: title, description "This is a complete task...", deadline Sep 5 (2026-09-05), priority High, and prerequisite "Buy groceries" (shown as incomplete). All submitted details are displayed and retained in the task list.

Task "Test Task FT5 Complete" with incomplete prerequisite shows disabled complete button (grayed out), displaying blocked state. The task is visibly distinguished from unblocked tasks which have enabled complete buttons.
Blocked task "Test Task FT5 Complete" displays prominent warning: "Prerequisite "Buy groceries" incomplete". The warning clearly identifies the single incomplete prerequisite task name.

Task "Buy groceries" was marked as completed: it left the active view, active count decreased from 4 to 3, completed count increased from 3 to 4. Task no longer appears in active list but moved to completed. Dependent task "Test Task FT5 Complete" complete button is now enabled.

Completed tab is now active. View shows only 4 completed tasks: Buy groceries, Reply to client emails, Review project proposal, Organize desk. Each displays title and priority. No active tasks are shown in completed view.
Attempted to create task with whitespace-only title ("   "). Create Task button remains disabled, preventing task creation. Task list unchanged.

When "Test Task FT5 Complete" had incomplete prerequisite "Buy groceries", its complete button was disabled. After completing "Buy groceries", the complete button became enabled, allowing task completion. Prerequisite validation works correctly.

Completed tasks (Buy groceries, Reply to client emails, Review project proposal, Organize desk) remain visible in Completed view with all original details (title, description, deadline, priority). Tasks are not deleted after completion.

Active view shows 3 tasks all displaying: title, priority (Medium/High), description (when supplied), deadline (when supplied). "Test Task FT5 Complete" shows prerequisite state. Completed view shows 4 tasks with same details. Active and completed tasks visually distinguished by tab grouping and button state.

Edited "Test Task FT4": changed title to "Test Task FT4 Updated", priority Low, added description "Updated description for FT-6 testing", deadline Sep 10. Changes were saved and retained. Task now displays all updated details with notification confirming update.

Assigned "Test Task FT5 Complete" as prerequisite to "Test Task FT4" via edit dialog. Task retained the dependency and now displays "Prerequisite \"Test Task FT5 Complete\" incomplete". Complete button disabled due to prerequisite.

issue: Blocked tasks have disabled edit button, preventing any editing of description, priority, title, or deadline. FT-3 requires editing description and priority for blocked tasks, but edit button is disabled.
actual: For blocked tasks, the edit button is disabled, making it impossible to open the edit dialog. No editing is possible for blocked tasks in the current implementation.

issue: Unable to verify circular dependency prevention. When adding prerequisites via edit dialog, no tasks appear disabled/unavailable to prevent cycles.
actual: All available tasks appear as selectable checkboxes without any indication of which would create cycles. No UI mechanism visible to prevent circular dependencies.

issue: Cannot test specific scenario: completing a prerequisite of a completed dependent task and checking if it returns to valid state. Blocked edit buttons prevent creating the necessary test scenario.
actual: Due to disabled edit buttons on blocked tasks and inability to manipulate prerequisite states after completion, the specific scenario described cannot be fully tested.

issue: No visual connections (dashed lines) detected between dependent tasks. Either not implemented or not visible in the accessibility/DOM tree.
actual: Examined task display multiple times; no visual connecting lines or graphics between tasks with dependencies are visible in the interface or DOM.

issue: Hovering over prerequisite warning text does not display a popup or tooltip showing dependency chain details.
actual: Attempted to hover over prerequisite warning "Prerequisite \"Test Task FT5 Complete\" incomplete"; no popup, tooltip, or additional UI elements appeared in the accessibility tree.
